name: First steroid cycle

lead: A first steroid cycle is the first time someone uses anabolic-androgenic steroids (AAS) for a set period, usually to build muscle, leanness and a more V-shaped, masculine physique. 'First cycle' threads are a staple of lifting and looksmaxxing forums.

Wikipedia notes that most non-medical users are not competitive athletes but men, median age around 25, using the drugs for appearance. Forum threads typically ask members to review a planned stack, and replies add or change items.

paras: In forum posts a first cycle is described as a limited block of an injectable testosterone ester, sometimes with other compounds, followed by what users call post-cycle therapy to restore natural production. Threads combine it with training and diet. No protocol is given here.

Documented effects include unfavorable cholesterol changes, acne, high blood pressure, liver strain with oral forms, heart enlargement, gynecomastia, testicular shrinkage, reduced sperm production, temporary suppression of natural testosterone and mood changes. In adolescents, AAS can prematurely close growth plates. They are controlled substances in many countries.

chain: Anabolic steroids activate the androgen receptor
Greater muscle growth and recovery with training
angle.text: Anabolic steroids increase muscle growth and help leaner mass accrue, which is why people use them to change their physique. A first cycle is the entry point to that route.

lead: A first steroid cycle is the initial planned course of anabolic-androgenic steroids taken by a person who wants more muscle, strength or a leaner, more masculine physique than training alone provides. The term 'cycle' reflects the pattern of using the drugs for a set block, then stopping, with a recovery phase in between [1].

The topic is among the most common on looksmax.org, where users post planned compound lists and ask for feedback; one thread from a 16-year-old lists several compounds and aims including bone growth, height and muscle [2]. Replies in such threads propose additional supplements or protective drugs [2]. The post-cycle phase is described in general terms as restoring natural testosterone production with agents such as clomifene or hCG [1].

Medically, AAS are testosterone-related drugs used for conditions such as delayed puberty, hypogonadism, wasting diseases and burn recovery [1]. Non-medical use is for appearance and performance; the compounds are Schedule III controlled substances in the United States, Class C in the UK, and controlled in many other countries, where black-market products may be counterfeit [1].
infobox: Controlled in US (Schedule III), UK (Class C) and elsewhere

paras: A cycle is a defined period of AAS use followed by a break, often with measures to restore natural testosterone afterwards [1]. The first cycle is the user's introduction and is usually described in forums as more conservative than later ones, though threads show a wide range of plans, including by teenagers [2].

Looksmax.org has many threads titled 'first cycle', often with the author's age, goals and planned compounds, and requests for feedback [2][3]. Some posters pair AAS with growth hormone or other agents for height or frame goals [2]. Replies commonly suggest additions such as liver-support supplements or hair-loss measures [2].

Wikipedia lists risks that rise with longer use or higher doses: cholesterol changes, acne, high blood pressure, liver damage with oral forms, and heart enlargement associated with heart attack, stroke and sudden cardiac death [1]. Hormonal effects include gynecomastia, testicular atrophy and reduced sperm production; psychiatric effects include aggression, mood swings and dependence [1]. In adolescents, early closure of growth plates can limit height [1]. Women may have irreversible changes such as voice deepening [1].

AAS are Schedule III in the United States, Schedule IV in Canada and Class C in the UK [1]. Where controlled, supply comes through smuggled, clandestine or counterfeit products [1]. Most major sporting bodies ban them [1].
No studies found on 'first cycles' specifically. Clinical literature exists on AAS for medical indications such as hypogonadism and burn recovery [1].

lore.intro: First-cycle threads on looksmax.org typically present a planned stack and invite critique [2][3].
